items.question: What services does Catalyst Analytics provide?
items.answer: Catalyst Analytics offers a range of services including design, engineering, web development, mobile app development, custom software development, branding and identity, and more. We specialize in user experience design and project management.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Project duration varies significantly based on complexity and scope. A small website might take 4-6 weeks, while a large custom software solution can take 3-6 months.

items.question: Do you offer post-launch support and maintenance?
items.answer: Yes, we provide various support packages to ensure your solution remains secure, up-to-date, and performs optimally after launch.

items.question: What is your pricing model?
items.answer: We primarily work on a fixed-price model for well-defined projects, and a time & material model for ongoing development or projects with evolving requirements.

items.question: Can you integrate with existing systems?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our engineering team specializes in API integration and ensuring seamless communication between new and existing platforms.
